title: I finally dreamed after 2 days !
content: I took 2 naps today and dreamed !!! I wasn’t in my mall world i was at home and that’s fine because it’s a place I go to in my dreams but only crazy shit happens and this time i had a boyfriend and my neighbors were trying to ram their car into my house lmao so happy i was able to dream because I know my mall world be there tonight!
